title: Moving Fields from Droppable Structs
goal: Access a struct field safely when the struct implements Drop.
hints: Rust must keep the entire struct valid so its Drop implementation can run.
Borrow the field instead of moving it out.
explanation: Because `Buffer` implements `Drop`, moving `buf.name` directly triggers `E0509` because partial moves leave the struct incomplete when `drop` runs. Borrowing `&buf.name` allows reading its length safely. Dereferencing `*buf.name` causes `E0614`, `clear()` on `&String` fails with `E0596` due to immutability, and explicit `Drop::drop` calls are forbidden by `E0040`.
